definitions.boundary_percentage: Runs off the bat from fours and sixes, excluding non-boundary hits, divided by batter runs and multiplied by 100.
definitions.economy: Bowler runs conceded, including wides and no-balls but excluding byes and leg byes, divided by legal balls and multiplied by 6.
definitions.qualification_rule: Bowlers qualify with at least 60 legal balls bowled across all seasons or 30 legal balls bowled in a selected season. Batters qualify with at least 60 balls faced across all seasons or 30 balls faced in a selected season; balls faced count every delivery except a wide, so no-balls count. Batters with zero runs are excluded.
definitions.run_rate: Team runs divided by legal balls, multiplied by 6.
definitions.team_records: Wins, losses, and ties from match results; a super-over eliminator does not change a tie. No-result matches are counted separately.
